title: Model Loader
description: Place animated Geckolib/ Blockbench models anywhere in the world. Configure their animations, textures, sounds and make them move with Waypoints ingame without any game restarts!
body:
A NeoForge mod for placing animated Geckolib/ Blockbench models in the world.

Drop a GeckoLib model into the config folder, place it with the Model Wand, and configure its animation, texture, sounds, and movement in-game.

Models can patrol waypoints, react to players getting close, and respond to interactions.

For a more detailed explanation of how the mod works take a look at the [docs](https://raydnde.github.io/animation-models-docs/)
